header.title: Consultancy & Services
header.intro: Independent nutrition expertise across the full spectrum of production species — from aquafeed to petfood, from single-question assignments to long-term partnerships.

speciesSection.title: The Animals I Work With
speciesSection.intro: Hover over a card — or tap on mobile — to explore expertise, example species, and key focus areas for each animal category.

species.label: Aquatic Animals
species.description: Aquafeed is one of the most technically demanding areas of feed formulation — species vary enormously in digestive physiology, nutrient requirements, and palatability. I have hands-on experience formulating for freshwater and marine species across multiple production systems, including recirculating aquaculture systems (RAS) and pond culture.

species.label: Amphibians & Reptiles
species.description: Amphibians and reptiles face some specific challenges concerning pathogens due to an environment of both water and air. Such animals require specialised nutritional attention.

species.label: Dogs & Cats
species.description: Petfood nutrition has its own regulatory framework (FEDIAF guidelines) and specific considerations — dogs with their special need of good quality feed in dry pelleted or extruded form – cats as obligate carnivores, with the need for taurine and arachidonic acid, and the unique challenges of palatability-driven formulation.

species.label: Poultry
species.description: Poultry nutrition is characterized by tight margins, high performance expectations, and significant sensitivity to feed quality. Possible work includes diet formulation for broilers and layers, additive evaluation (enzymes, acidifiers, additives), and premix specification.

species.label: Pigs
species.description: Pig nutrition requires particular attention to the transition periods — especially weaning and gilt development. I provide advice on complete diets, SCFA and MCFA applications for gut health, and reduction strategies in antibiotic-free or reduced programs.

species.label: Ruminants
species.description: Ruminant nutrition spans a wide range of production goals — milk yield, milk composition, growth rate, and reproductive performance. Services include premix formulation, total mixed ration (TMR) optimization, and trace element and vitamin specification.

sections.imageAlt: Laboratory analysis and diet formulation work
sections.title: Nutritional Advisory
sections.intro: Science-based nutritional advice from raw material selection to final ration — delivered independently, without supplier bias. Every recommendation is grounded in current literature and verified against practical experience across species.

services.title: Diet formulation & optimization
services.text: Full ration formulation and reformulation for all species, built in Bestmix with validated nutrient matrices. Covers energy system selection (DE, ME, NE), amino acid requirement setting, and least-cost optimization within your raw material constraints and budget targets.

services.title: Feasibility studies — additives
services.text: Independent evaluation of feed additives including enzymes, organic acids, SCFA, MCFA, yeasts and yeast derivatives, mycotoxin binders, and probiotics. Includes systematic literature review, dose-response assessment, species-specific applicability, and return-on-investment estimation.

services.title: Feasibility studies — raw materials
services.text: Assessment of new or alternative raw materials and co-products — wet and dry. Covers digestibility coefficients, quality risk, batch variability, safe inclusion levels, and interaction effects with other dietary components.

services.title: Compound feed, ration & premix advice
services.text: Critical review and targeted optimization of existing compound feed formulations, total mixed rations (TMR), and premix specifications for any production species. Ideal for matching formulations for research or setting up formulations for testing additives & minerals.

sections.imageAlt: Feed mill and raw material handling
sections.title: Technical Support
sections.intro: Practical support at the place where nutrition becomes feed — the mill, the farm, or the field. Combining formulation knowledge with process awareness to resolve issues that purely desk-based analysis cannot catch.

services.title: On-site support at client locations
services.text: Hands-on technical assistance at feed mills, commercial farms, exhibitions, and aquaculture facilities. Scope includes production troubleshooting, raw material evaluation at goods receipt, process audits (pelleting temperatures, mixer uniformity), and performance investigation.

services.title: Bestmix formulation system setup & maintenance
services.text: Building and maintaining complete Bestmix environments — nutrient matrices with species-appropriate coefficients, ingredient libraries, energy systems, constraint structures, and labelling configurations. Suitable for new implementations or rebuilding the formulation set-up.

services.title: Energy calculation & requirement setting
services.text: Reviewing and correctly configuring energy systems (DE, ME, NE) and nutritional requirement profiles in Bestmix for each target species and production stage. Includes validation against published standards and in-house performance data.

sections.title: Raw Materials & Co-Products
sections.intro: Co-products and alternative ingredients offer real cost and sustainability advantages, but only when their variability, quality risks, and interaction effects are properly managed. I provide both the nutritional analysis and the procurement frameworks to use them confidently.

services.title: Wet co-products
services.text: Evaluation, quality monitoring, and safe inclusion protocols for wet by-products: distillers' grains (DDGS wet), potato steam peels, brewery spent grains, starch fractions, dairy whey, and other moisture-rich industrial by-products. Includes mycotoxin and contamination risk assessment.

services.title: Dry co-products & alternative proteins
services.text: Assessment of dry co-products and protein sources including DDGS, canola/rapeseed meal, sunflower meal, insect meal (BSF, mealworm), single-cell proteins, and regional agricultural by-products. Covers nutrient matrix development, anti-nutritional factors, and validated inclusion levels per species.

services.title: Raw material knowledge training
services.text: Structured knowledge transfer for procurement and nutritional teams on the origin, processing methods, nutritional composition, quality indicators, and risk profile of each raw material category in their portfolio. Building up a raw material matrix jointly. Delivered on-site or remotely.

sections.imageAlt: In-company training session on feed additives
sections.title: Courses & Training
sections.intro: Customer-specific courses designed around your team, your species, and your current knowledge level — not generic slide decks. All courses are available in Dutch, German or English and can be delivered on-site or as interactive remote sessions.

services.title: Raw material knowledge course
services.text: A practical course on the raw materials your company buys and uses — covering origin, processing, nutritional value, typical quality ranges, quality indicators to use at reception, and key risks per ingredient category. Customized to your actual ingredient portfolio.

services.title: Feed additives: yeasts & enzymes
services.text: In-depth training on yeast-based products (live yeast, yeast cell wall fractions, beta-glucans, MOS) and enzymes (phytases, NSP-degrading carbohydrases, proteases) — modes of action, substrate specificity, thermostability, selection criteria, and application by species.

services.title: Feed additives: SCFA, MCFA, and organic acids
services.text: Understanding short-chain and medium-chain fatty acid products, organic acid blends, and acidifier applications — antimicrobial mechanisms, gut acidification, gastric pH management, and practical selection in antibiotic-reduced or antibiotic-free production programs.

services.title: Feed additives: mycotoxin management
services.text: Comprehensive mycotoxin risk management: mycotoxin types and producing fungi, sampling strategies, analytical methods, risk thresholds by species, binder technology types (bentonite, HSCAS, yeast cell wall, enzyme-based), efficacy evaluation, and regulatory context in the EU.

bestmix.title: Bestmix Formulation
bestmix.text: All formulation work is carried out in Bestmix — the industry-standard feed formulation platform. This includes building ingredient libraries, setting nutritional requirements, configuring energy systems, running least-cost optimizations, and maintaining audit-ready formulation records. I can also set up or rebuild your company's Bestmix environment from scratch.

cta.text: Reach out to discuss your species, challenge, or project — all enquiries are welcome.
